name: std::set<Key,Compare,Allocator>::key_comp
intro: Returns the function object that compares the keys, which is a copy of this container's constructor argument comp. It is the same as value_comp.

examples.output:
Key (1) goes before key (100)
Key (2) goes before key (100)
Key (3) equivalent to key (100)
Key (4) goes after key (100)
Key (5) goes after key (100)
